summary: WISeKey International Holding AG filed a 6-K disclosing completion of its redomiciliation from Switzerland to the British Virgin Islands via a cross-border merger into wholly owned subsidiary WISeQey Corp., legally effective October 1, 2026. Existing ADSs continue trading on Nasdaq and Class B shares on SIX through October 2, 2026; WISeQey ordinary shares begin trading as WQEY on both venues October 5, 2026. Exchange terms: each ADS converts to one-half ordinary share, each Class B share to one ordinary share, or ten unlisted Class B shares on election. Watch settlement mechanics, index inclusion and post-merger flow.
